title: Krishnamurti and Osho: Two Teachers of Freedom
description: What J. Krishnamurti and Osho taught about freedom, awareness, thought, love and meditation, where their teachings meet, and where they sharply part.
audience: Curious beginners. No background in philosophy or spirituality needed.

chapters.title: Two Teachers, One Map
chapters.summary: Tour the core ideas of both teachers and how they connect, then rebuild the map from memory.

chapters.title: The Pathless Land Case
chapters.summary: Why did the young man raised to be a 'World Teacher' walk away in 1929? Crack the case and find what Krishnamurti taught instead.

chapters.title: Zorba the Buddha
chapters.summary: Everyday situations seen through Osho's teaching: meditation, desire, love, religion and celebration.

chapters.title: Krishnamurti or Osho?
chapters.summary: Ten situations, two teachers: work out how each would respond, and why they differ.

chapters.title: Islands of Awareness
chapters.summary: One island per big idea from both teachers, hands-on activities, then a final exam.
